_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
hawks: The Hawks' season runs late October to April at State Farm Arena, 41 home dates, with the play-in and the playoffs beyond that.
falcons: The Falcons' season runs September to January at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, with the playoffs beyond that; flex-week kickoffs fill in above as the league confirms them.
braves: Spring training opens in North Port in February and the regular season in late March at Truist Park; the schedule above fills in once MLB publishes it.
united: Atlanta United's MLS season runs late February to October at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, 17 home matches, with the Cup playoffs through early December.
dream: The Dream's WNBA season runs May to September at Gateway Center Arena in College Park, with the playoffs beyond that; the schedule arrives over the winter.
yellowjackets: Georgia Tech's football season runs late August to November at Bobby Dodd Stadium, with the ACC Championship and the College Football Playoff beyond that.
